questions.stem: What happens during the first stage of labour?

options.text: The baby is delivered through the vagina
The placenta is expelled from the uterus
The cervix dilates and the amniotic sac breaks

questions.explanation: During the first stage of labour, the cervix gradually dilates (widens) to allow the baby to pass through, and the amniotic sac usually breaks, releasing the amniotic fluid.
